content.user_title: Optimize Application Performance Across the Stack
content.value_statement: Performance bottlenecks slow releases, increase costs, and damage user experience. This skill guides profiling, optimization, load testing, and monitoring across frontend, backend, database, and infrastructure layers.
actual_capabilities: Guides baseline profiling with APM data, tracing, flame graphs, memory analysis, and user journey metrics.
Coordinates database, backend, API, and distributed system optimization work from profiling evidence.
Plans frontend bundle, CDN, edge, mobile, and Progressive Web App performance improvements.
Designs load tests, performance regression tests, performance budgets, and CI guardrails.
Defines monitoring dashboards, alerts, SLIs, SLOs, runbooks, and continuous optimization reviews.
limitations: Requires metrics, profiling data, traces, logs, or load-test results for best results.
Does not run tests, deploy changes, or provision monitoring systems by itself.
Production load testing still requires approvals, safeguards, and clear rollback plans.
Recommendations must be validated in the target environment before broad rollout.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Slow Services
use_cases.description: Find backend, database, and API bottlenecks using profiling data and clear target metrics.

use_cases.title: Improve Web Experience
use_cases.description: Use Core Web Vitals, bundle analysis, CDN tuning, and mobile checks to improve user-facing speed.

use_cases.title: Plan Scalable Releases
use_cases.description: Build load tests, performance budgets, alerts, and capacity plans before major launch traffic.

prompt_templates.title: Baseline Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my application performance. Start with baseline metrics, key user journeys, obvious bottlenecks, and the safest next checks.

prompt_templates.title: Targeted Bottleneck Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to optimize this slow workflow: [describe workflow]. Include profiling questions, likely backend, database, and frontend causes, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Load Test Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a load test plan for [application]. Cover traffic models, test stages, metrics, approval needs, safeguards, and rollback criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Enterprise Optimization Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a full performance optimization program for [system]. Include baselines, phased workstreams, observability gaps, budgets, owners, risks, and continuous review.

output_examples.input: Review checkout latency and propose improvements.
output_examples.output: A prioritized performance report with baseline metrics, suspected bottlenecks, database and API actions, validation tests, and rollout guardrails.

output_examples.input: Prepare our product for a large launch event.
output_examples.output: A launch readiness plan covering load scenarios, expected traffic, monitoring needs, alert thresholds, rollback rules, and capacity checkpoints.

output_examples.input: Improve Core Web Vitals for the main dashboard.
output_examples.output: A frontend optimization plan with bundle analysis, rendering fixes, image and CDN guidance, mobile checks, and measurement criteria.

best_practices: Start with measured baselines before choosing optimizations.
Define target metrics, budgets, and rollback criteria before testing changes.
Validate each improvement with controlled tests and production monitoring.
anti_patterns: Optimizing code paths without profiling evidence.
Load testing production without approval, safeguards, and rollback plans.
Shipping performance changes without regression tests or monitoring updates.

faq.question: What does this skill optimize?
faq.answer: It covers frontend, backend, database, infrastructure, CDN, load testing, observability, and continuous performance management.

faq.question: Does this skill require APM tools?
faq.answer: No. APM data helps, but profiling data, traces, logs, user metrics, and load-test results can also guide the work.

faq.question: Can it help with Core Web Vitals?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes user experience analysis, bundle optimization, rendering improvements, resource hints, CDN tuning, and mobile performance work.

faq.question: Can it create a load testing plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides realistic traffic models, normal load, peak load, stress tests, key metrics, safeguards, and pass or fail criteria.

faq.question: Is it safe to use for production systems?
faq.answer: Yes, when teams follow approvals, gradual rollout, monitoring, and rollback guidance. Production load tests require explicit safeguards.
